note: DRAFT — Keyboard layout for a browser side-scroller (keyboard primary, mouse used for the basic attack and UI clicks). Keys can be remapped later; these are the v0 defaults. Number-row skill and potion hotkeys stay visible on a simple hotbar. Do not capture browser-reserved keys (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, F5). Placeholders. v0.1.3: hotbar slots 1–6 each hold a skill or a consumable; 5 and 6 default to Meadow Dew and Clear Dew. v0.2.1: quest journal is on J.

rows.notes: Hold to walk left. Arrow keys are an alternative to WASD.
Hold to walk right.
Variable jump in v0 is not required; a single fixed jump is fine for the prototype. W also jumps so WASD stays complete.
Optional. Drop through a one-way platform. Skip in v0.1 if platforms are all solid.
The default swing (skill multiplier 1.0). Does not spend MP.
Pick up a nearby drop, talk to an NPC, or use a path/portal when standing in its trigger. Hold is not required.
Hotbar slot 1. Default: Power Strike. Can be rebound to any known skill or consumable (select in the skills or inventory window, press 1–6).
Skill hotkey 2. Warrior default: Rage.
Skill hotkey 3. Empty until a third skill is unlocked.
Skill hotkey 4. Empty until a fourth skill is unlocked.
Hotbar slot 5. Default on new (and migrated) saves: Meadow Dew. Bind any consumable from the inventory.
Hotbar slot 6. Default: Clear Dew. Bind any consumable from the inventory.
Toggle inventory. Esc also closes it.
Toggle the skills window (view ranks, pay a rank-up cost).
Toggle character / ability-point screen (STR, INT, AGI, SPI).
Toggle the passive tree (production, efficiency, Hunter's Luck).
Toggle the area map (Meadows areas and the current path).
v0.2.1: Toggle the quest journal. Keyboard-first, same as K and I. The sheet used L; J is free and reads as Journal.
Close the topmost window, or pause if no window is open. Does not quit the browser tab.
v0.2.3: Toggle the on-screen quest objectives tracker. J still opens the full journal. L was free after the journal moved to J.
